summary: Cause of the r5 'layout 0 devices' determined: it was a hierarchy artifact, not missing geometry. The routed GDS carries transistor-level geometry and the deck extracts it (678 devices across 84 library-cell circuits in r5's device.finfet_bulk_tied warnings; 30714 devices once the layout is flattened in r6). r5 counted only the top circuit, which holds no direct devices, against a flattened reference. With options.flatten_layout true the compare still returns mismatch: layout 30714 devices vs reference 29356, 43 matched.
note: ASAP7 is predictive; tool result only. Append-only; r1-r5 left as written. The netlist, layout and deck were not edited; power_connectivity and supply_nets not waived.
request_notes: r5 request plus options.flatten_layout: true. pdk_root and pin_order_files as in r5 (pinned lambdapdk v0.2.17 tree, unpacked in /tmp scratch, not committed).
upstream: 2AMLogic/klayout-tools#4954 (open): finger-merge remedy unavailable on FinFET decks
not_done: The netlist, layout, deck and options were not edited to force a match; no option was waived (power_connectivity and supply_nets untouched, per decision 0005). finfet_bulk is the same assertion as r2 to r4 and the report flags it as device.finfet_bulk_tied warnings.
klt_source: throwaway uvx env, uvx --with klayout --from klayout-tools==0.9.0 klt lvs --format json (single local run, about 7 min)
observed: layout devices 30714 vs reference 29356 (43 matched), nets 16411 vs 15718 (174 matched), pins 201 vs 266. 286 device.unmerged_fingers errors: 2 parallel layout fingers sum to the width of one reference device. net.supply_fragmented on 84 library-cell circuits (VDD in 2 nets; shipped cells carry no tap). 68 hints.rejected.
unmerged_fingers_remedy: The report names options.combine_devices: true; a request setting it was refused by klt 0.9.0 on the asap7 FinFET deck ('options.combine_devices is not supported ... FinFET fingers are always merged by the extractor'). No report from that refused request exists. Filed as 2AMLogic/klayout-tools#4954.
cause_determined: Commands: klayout.db read of layout/slice_routed.gds (99 cells, 29 layer/datatype pairs incl. fin/gate/contact layers inside the standard-cell cells); r5 report mismatches[].category == device.finfet_bulk_tied, sum of details.device_count = 678 over 84 circuits. Reference was flattened (flatten_reference true) while r5 left the layout hierarchical, so the top layout circuit counted 0 devices.
